description: This Kotlin source file contains the implementation of gateway configuration resolution and parsing logic for an Android application. It defines data classes representing gateway endpoints, configurations, and validation errors, as well as functions for decoding setup codes, parsing URLs, and resolving connection configurations based on user input or saved data.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration details of a gateway endpoint, including host, port, TLS usage, and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Holds the information decoded from a setup code, including URL and optional security tokens and password.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Contains the details necessary to establish a connection to a gateway, including credentials and host info.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible validation errors when processing gateway endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the source of user input for gateway endpoint configuration.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Contains the result of parsing a gateway endpoint URL, including config or error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of scanning and decoding a setup code, including any errors.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Resolves connection configuration based on user input, saved settings, or fallback values.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw gateway endpoint URL string into a GatewayEndpointConfig.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Analyzes a raw URL string, normalizes it, and returns parsing result including validation.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded setup code string into a GatewaySetupCode object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Attempts to interpret a scanned input as a valid setup code URL.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Provides detailed result of trying to decode and parse a scanned setup code.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Generates user-facing validation messages based on endpoint validation errors and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Constructs a manual gateway URL from host, port, and TLS preference inputs.
